info.title: External API вЂ” Fitness CRM
info.description: Third-party access to the Fitness CRM, authenticated by a per-company static bearer token (Sanctum personal access token, tokenable = Company). The company tenant is derived from the token вЂ” do NOT send the `company` UUID header used by the mobile API. Client-scoped endpoints additionally require the target client's `company_clients.api_token`, passed as the `X-Client-Token` header (or an `api_token` parameter), resolved scoped to the token's company.

post.summary: Send an SMS login code to a phone
post.description: Step 1 of obtaining a client's api_token. Sends a one-time code to the phone; the code is then exchanged at /login (existing client) or supplied to /register (new client).

post.summary: Exchange phone + SMS code for the client's api_token
post.description: Step 2 (existing client). Returns the client profile including `token` вЂ” the client's `company_clients.api_token`, used as the X-Client-Token header on client-scoped endpoints. Auto-creates the company link if missing. Returns 404 `client_not_found` when the phone is not registered yet (then call /register).

200.description:
Booking result. The success body depends on the resolved payment source (`payment_mode`,
or `auto` resolved to the first available of abonement в†’ balance в†’ card в†’ cash):
- **abonement** вЂ” the lesson is written off an active subscription (`lessons_before`/`lessons_after`).
- **balance** вЂ” the lesson is charged to the client's balance (`balance_before`/`balance_after`).
- **cash** вЂ” booked and marked paid in cash; no balance/abonement detail.
- **card** / **online** вЂ” no immediate booking confirmation; a payment redirect (`{url, order}`) is returned and the booking is confirmed once the gateway callback settles.
- **legacy** вЂ” calls sent with `type_payment` (no `payment_mode`) and a non-online type return the bare confirmation without `payment_source_used`.

oneOf.title: Card / online вЂ” payment redirect
oneOf.description: payment_mode=card (or autoв†’card), and the legacy type_payment=3 online flow.

message.description:
Root OpenAPI definition for the external / third-party API.

The external API reuses the existing App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1 controllers,
so the spec lives here (in app/OpenApi) rather than in those shared
controllers. It documents the auth scheme and every endpoint exposed by
routes/api/external_v1.php; see external-api-endpoints.md for an overview.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated context is not allowed to perform this action.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (e.g. client not found within the token's company).

message.example: Client not found for this company.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded (300 requests/minute per token).

companyToken.description: Per-company static token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

clientToken.description: The target client's `company_clients.api_token`. Required for client-scoped endpoints; resolved within the company of the bearer token.
clientToken.name: X-Client-Token
